standard-dialogue-while-wearing-khazard-.npc: Hmm... You don't seem like a real guard to me. Who are you?

standard-dialogue-without-a-disguise.npc: You're not a guard. What are you doing in here?

standard-dialogue-after-getting-captured.npc: Hello there. So Khazard got his hands on you too?
Well if you're lucky, you might last as long as me.

standard-dialogue-after-getting-captured.player: How long have you been here?

standard-dialogue-after-getting-captured.npc: As long as I can remember. I was a child when his men kidnapped me. My whole life has been spent killing and fighting, all in the hope that one day I might escape.
Wait... sounds like the guard is coming. Looks like you'll be going back into the arena. Good luck, friend.

standard-dialogue-after-defeating-bounce.npc: I don't know how you managed to escape, but you may not be as lucky next time. Get out of here while you can.
